aws-firehose:write-insert:v2.notes: Delivers streaming records (Direct PUT, Kinesis Data Streams or MSK) to Iceberg tables in Amazon S3 or S3 Tables. Insert is the default operation, and an AppendOnly flag lifts the throughput cap when no updates or deletes are needed.
caveats: JSON records only, one object per Firehose record
Column names and types must match the table exactly; mismatches go to the S3 error bucket

aws-firehose:write-insert:v3.notes: Firehose only supports Iceberg V2 tables (AWS prerequisites page; Iceberg library 1.5.2), so V3 tables cannot be delivered to.

aws-firehose:write-merge-update-delete:v.notes: Each record can carry an insert, update or delete operation, set through a JSONQuery expression or a Lambda transform. Updates and deletes need UniqueKeys on the stream or identifier-field-ids on the table; an update is a delete file followed by an insert.
caveats: Records are not delivered in order
Global deletes (unpartitioned delete files on a partitioned table) are not supported
Each update writes a delete file, which incurs S3 PUT charges

aws-firehose:write-merge-update-delete:v.notes: Firehose only supports Iceberg V2 tables (AWS prerequisites page; Iceberg library 1.5.2), so V3 tables cannot be delivered to.

aws-firehose:merge-on-read:v2.notes: AWS states that Firehose supports the Merge-on-Read mode of writing to Iceberg tables.

aws-firehose:merge-on-read:v3.notes: Firehose only supports Iceberg V2 tables (AWS prerequisites page; Iceberg library 1.5.2), so V3 tables cannot be delivered to.

aws-firehose:equality-deletes:v2.notes: Firehose writes equality delete files for updates and deletes, keyed on the stream's UniqueKeys or the table's identifier-field-ids. AWS describes an update as a delete file followed by an insert.
caveats: Needs UniqueKeys on the stream or identifier-field-ids on the table; without them update and delete records go to the S3 error bucket
Delete files are partition-scoped; global deletes (unpartitioned delete files on a partitioned table) are not supported
Each update writes a delete file, which incurs S3 PUT charges

aws-firehose:equality-deletes:v3.notes: Firehose only supports Iceberg V2 tables (AWS prerequisites page; Iceberg library 1.5.2), so V3 tables cannot be delivered to.

aws-firehose:position-deletes:v2.notes: Firehose's deletes are key-based equality deletes; it has no position-delete path.

aws-firehose:position-deletes:v3.notes: Firehose only supports Iceberg V2 tables (AWS prerequisites page; Iceberg library 1.5.2), so V3 tables cannot be delivered to.

aws-firehose:deletion-vectors:v2.notes: Deletion vectors are a V3 feature; not applicable to V2.

aws-firehose:deletion-vectors:v3.notes: Firehose only supports Iceberg V2 tables (AWS prerequisites page; Iceberg library 1.5.2), so V3 tables cannot be delivered to.

aws-firehose:table-creation:v2.notes: Firehose does not create tables. They must already exist and be created through Iceberg's GlueCatalog API; tables created with the Glue SDK are not supported.
caveats: With UniqueKeys configured, Firehose validates that the table exists when the stream is created

aws-firehose:table-creation:v3.notes: Firehose only supports Iceberg V2 tables (AWS prerequisites page; Iceberg library 1.5.2), so V3 tables cannot be delivered to.

aws-firehose:schema-evolution:v2.notes: Column names and data types must exactly match the target table, otherwise records go to the S3 error bucket. Fields the table lacks are skipped, not added.

aws-firehose:schema-evolution:v3.notes: Firehose only supports Iceberg V2 tables (AWS prerequisites page; Iceberg library 1.5.2), so V3 tables cannot be delivered to.

aws-firehose:type-promotion:v2.notes: No automatic type change: values whose type does not match the table column are rejected to the S3 error bucket.

aws-firehose:type-promotion:v3.notes: Firehose only supports Iceberg V2 tables (AWS prerequisites page; Iceberg library 1.5.2), so V3 tables cannot be delivered to.

aws-firehose:table-maintenance:v2.notes: Firehose does not compact or expire snapshots. AWS recommends Glue Data Catalog automatic compaction, or Athena OPTIMIZE and VACUUM, and notes every write adds snapshots, data files and delete files.
caveats: S3 Tables performs its own automatic maintenance, outside Firehose

aws-firehose:table-maintenance:v3.notes: Firehose only supports Iceberg V2 tables (AWS prerequisites page; Iceberg library 1.5.2), so V3 tables cannot be delivered to.

aws-firehose:branching-tagging:v2.notes: AWS documents no branch or tag option in the Iceberg destination configuration.

aws-firehose:branching-tagging:v3.notes: Firehose only supports Iceberg V2 tables (AWS prerequisites page; Iceberg library 1.5.2), so V3 tables cannot be delivered to.

aws-firehose:hidden-partitioning:v2.notes: Firehose delivers to partitioned Iceberg tables, writing each record into the partition the table's spec assigns it, including partition-scoped delete files. The partition spec itself comes from the table, not from Firehose.
caveats: The table, with its partitioning, must be created before the Firehose stream: Firehose does not create tables or define partition specs
Global deletes (unpartitioned delete files on a partitioned table) are not supported
The number of partitions that can be written actively falls as ingest throughput rises (about 3,000 up to 20 MB/s, down to 1 at 750 MB/s to 1.5 GB/s)

aws-firehose:hidden-partitioning:v3.notes: Firehose only supports Iceberg V2 tables (AWS prerequisites page; Iceberg library 1.5.2), so V3 tables cannot be delivered to.

aws-firehose:catalog-integration:v2.notes: Glue Data Catalog only, including S3 Tables through its Glue integration. No REST, Hive or other catalogs.
caveats: Tables must be created through Iceberg's GlueCatalog API; hyphens are not allowed in database or table names
S3 Tables column names must be lowercase

aws-firehose:catalog-integration:v3.notes: Firehose only supports Iceberg V2 tables (AWS prerequisites page; Iceberg library 1.5.2), so V3 tables cannot be delivered to.

aws-firehose:aws-glue-catalog:v2.notes: Delivers to Iceberg tables in the AWS Glue Data Catalog, in self-managed S3 or in S3 Tables.

aws-firehose:aws-glue-catalog:v3.notes: Firehose only supports Iceberg V2 tables (AWS prerequisites page; Iceberg library 1.5.2), so V3 tables cannot be delivered to.

aws-firehose:rest-catalog:v2.notes: Only the Glue Data Catalog is supported as the table catalog; no Iceberg REST catalog option.

aws-firehose:rest-catalog:v3.notes: Firehose only supports Iceberg V2 tables (AWS prerequisites page; Iceberg library 1.5.2), so V3 tables cannot be delivered to.

aws-firehose:variant-type:v2.notes: V3 feature; not applicable to V2.

aws-firehose:variant-type:v3.notes: Firehose only supports Iceberg V2 tables (AWS prerequisites page; Iceberg library 1.5.2), so V3 tables cannot be delivered to.

aws-firehose:shredded-variant:v2.notes: V3 feature; not applicable to V2.

aws-firehose:shredded-variant:v3.notes: Firehose only supports Iceberg V2 tables (AWS prerequisites page; Iceberg library 1.5.2), so V3 tables cannot be delivered to.
